verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer runs client-facing digital tools (GDHQ, Contract Generator, Catalyze), so publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question, but the evidence shows none. The probe returned HTTP 404 at gunder.com/llms.txt, and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation for any of its platforms. ChatGD is an internal attorney tool and does not count as agent-readable docs for users.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
